items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: Lee Wiley was at the end of her days you know, and she wrote me the nicest note later thanking me.

ctx.x: It sure does. Your point of view.
Well you’ve written arrangements for Maxine Sullivan and some other singers, Lee Wiley.
Yeah. Wonderful, wonderful. We had lunch with Dick Hyman’s wife a couple of years ago at the Mohonk Mountain House or something.
